_derivation.derivedFrom: ./dot-286764.active.derived.json — itself derived from the real Socrata record for GENERAL TRANSPORT INC, DOT 286764 / MC-186800
_derivation.shapeSource: https://mobile.fmcsa.dot.gov/QCDevsite/docs/apiElements — documented element names, not an observed response
_derivation.note: GENERAL TRANSPORT INC is a real, active, Satisfactory-rated carrier. It is NOT under an out-of-service order. This file is a hand-built test input and must never be presented as a finding about that company.
_derivation.replaceWhen: An FMCSA WebKey is obtained. Find a carrier genuinely under an OOS order, record it, and delete this file.
